title: Mother went to South Australia police station day before suspected murder-suicide
summary_full: Police say chance of finding missing baby alive ‘zero’ after bodies of mother Helena Wright and toddler found in ocean near Port MacdonnellGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastA mother who died in a suspected murder-suicide went to the police station a day before the incident, South Australia police have confirmed.The bodies of Helena Wright, 36, and her 23-month-old daughter were found in the ocean west of Port Macdonnell on Monday.
